editorial:
Imagine a waiting room filled with the weirdest bugs you have ever seen. You get to meet Citronella, a mosquito who is terrified of blood, which is a pretty big problem for her species. She is joining a therapy group led by Dr. Pill, a calm pill bug who tries to keep everyone sane. You will laugh at the cast of characters, like the coffee-addicted grasshopper who can't sit still and the stick bug who is sad that he is too good at hiding. The whole vibe is light, quirky, and feels like a funny sketch show brought to life with animation.

What really works here is how the movie uses these bug traits to poke fun at human habits. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the jokes are a bit simple. If you want something easy to watch that makes you smile, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: In the end, Citronella finally stops running away and admits her fear of blood to the group. This honesty helps the other bugs realize that everyone has something embarrassing to deal with. The twist is that by sharing her secret, she actually helps the other neurotic bugs feel more normal. They all find a sense of peace together, and Citronella learns that she can be a mosquito her own way.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky characters and short, funny stories.
